title: 28 贺长老的邀请29 拍卖会上的嚣张修士
content_zh:
将购买的三品炼丹炉拿出来之后，洛豪同时将真心草以及一些辅助药材同时放进了丹炉中，然后开始使用真火将这些药材给融化而提纯，这也是炼丹的第一步，这一步只许成功不许失败，洛豪不停的变化手势，同时神识也时刻监控着炼丹炉里的情况，因为是第一次炼丹，所以洛豪格外的小心。
半炷香过后，洛豪总算将药材提纯完整，虽然纯度不是百分之百，但也有百分之九十五左右，洛豪知道不是他不能提纯百分之百，也不是他的炼丹手法有问题，而是他没有一个奇异火种，奇异火种是炼丹师必备的物品之一，就像鱼离不开水一样，炼丹师如果没有奇异火种，那炼丹师也就永远不可能晋级到更高层次了。
如果是其他炼丹师，就使用普通的真火很难将药材提纯到百分之九十以上，洛豪能够提纯到百分之九十五已经算是非常的厉害了。
将药材提纯之后，洛豪开始炼制丹药，一道又一道的炼丹手决被洛豪打进炼丹炉中，并且洛豪还用神识控制着药液的旋转，随着洛豪的手决不停的打入，那些提纯出来的药液也开始慢慢的凝固起来，然后又分解，然后又凝固，一炷香过后，丹炉当中的药液开始渐渐有了灵性。
一阵丹香飘飞出来，当洛豪闻到这一阵丹香就知道聚真丹已经炼制成功，洛豪随手一拉，十二颗聚真丹就被洛豪拉了出来，然后洛豪拿出一个玉瓶将十二颗聚真丹装在了其中，然后伸手擦了擦头上的汗水。
看了看玉瓶中的十二颗聚真丹，全部都是上品，洛豪还是比较满意的，这一次炼制并没有消耗他太多的真元，倒是神识消耗了不少，不过休息了一会儿，洛豪的神识也恢复的差不多了。洛豪接下来又炼制了一炉回血丹，一炉回春丹，一炉神灵丹，当炼制完这三炉丹药之后，洛豪的真元和神识都消耗了大半，好在回春丹和神灵丹都可以吃下弥补丢失的真元和神识。
所以洛豪立即就吞下了一枚回春丹和一枚神灵丹，不得不说丹药和灵草之间的恢复效果完全不可相提并论，以往恢复真元和神识，洛豪都要消耗好几株的回元根和好几株神灵草才能恢复完整，而这次，他只是吞下一枚神灵草炼制的神灵丹就恢复了神识，一枚回元根炼制的回春丹就恢复了真元。
成功炼制了这些丹药，洛豪知道他已经是一个一品炼丹师了，接下来他还要炼制一炉破真丹和一炉凝元丹，至于草灵丹洛豪暂时没有想过要炼制，因为他现在还暂时用不到草灵丹，因为草灵丹要在他成丹期的时候炼制才比较合适。等洛豪炼制完成凝元丹，洛豪就是一个二品炼丹师了，事实上炼制完破真丹，洛豪就可以算是一个二品炼丹师，因为破真丹也可以算作二品丹药。
又是一炷香过去，洛豪终于炼制完成一炉破真丹，将十二颗破真丹拿了二颗装在另一个玉瓶中，洛豪就将另外的十颗破真丹装在玉瓶中然后放进了混沌书中，其它炼制的包括回血丹，回春丹和神灵丹都被洛豪放进了混沌书中，只有聚真丹，洛豪还留在了储物袋中，因为炼制完丹药之后，洛豪就打算在这里突破成为结真中期，他相信十二颗聚真丹足够他突破到结真中期了。
又是一炷香过去，洛豪也炼制完成一炉十二颗凝元丹，然后洛豪又在洞府门口布置了一个三级防御阵法和一个三级困阵，接着又放下了一个监控阵盘，准备充分之后洛豪就进入了混沌书，洛豪知道他突破的动静非常大，哪怕他布置阵法也别想掩盖住，所以洛豪决定在混沌书中突破，至于布置监控防御阵法和困阵是怕有人来洞府打扰他。
进入混沌书之后，洛豪随便找了一个地方就盘坐下来，然后吞下一枚聚真丹，聚真丹吞下肚的那一瞬间就化成药液充斥着洛豪的经脉，无数的灵气开始转化成真元，洛豪舒服的就像洗了一个澡，洗去身上的脏东西一般。
洛豪的头顶开始出现一个灵气漩涡，然后洛豪开始冲击结真中期的经脉屏障，无数的真元冲击着经脉的屏障，然而一个小时过去之后，洛豪发现一枚聚真丹根本不能让他突破到结真中期，于是洛豪再次吞下一枚聚真丹，终于这一枚聚真丹在转化为无数的真元冲击着洛豪的经脉，只听咔嚓一声，感受到经脉的碎裂然后又扩张，洛豪知道自己终于突破成为结真中期了，感受到结真中期强大的真元，洛豪长啸一声，感觉一身的轻松。
二天过去，贺长老已经等得有些不耐烦了，正想强行闯入洛豪的洞府，而在这时，洛豪终于出了洞府，经过一晚上的巩固，洛豪终于将自己的结真中期实力给巩固了，然后洛豪算算三天时间差不多快要到了，洛豪就没有继续修炼突破，而是打算前往拍卖会，没想到当他一出洞府，就看到等候着就要强行闯入他的洞府的贺长老。
洛豪定睛一看，这是一个瘦小的老头，还留着一把胡子，再看他的实力，洛豪大吃一惊，这个老头居然是成丹初期实力，这个老头来这里找他干什么，同时洛豪的心里也十分的警惕起来。
看到洛豪出来，贺长老双手抱了抱拳，“这位小兄弟可否聊一下?“
“不知前辈找我有什么事情?“洛豪虽然心里十分的警惕，但表面上还是装作十分镇定，虽然他打不过这个老头，但只要让他找到机会，他可以施展神识遁逃走。
“我是贺州坊市的管事人，你也可以叫我贺长老，我听闻小兄弟在贺州商楼买了一个三品炼丹炉，不知道小兄弟是不是一位三品炼丹师?“贺长老十分平静的询问洛豪。
洛豪闻言心里就是一惊，没想到自己刚买了一个炼丹炉就被人盯上了，虽然心里十分忌惮这个老头，但洛豪还是恭敬的回答，“我是一位三品炼丹师，前辈找我是要炼制丹药?“
贺长老闻言开心一笑，“没错，我是想找小兄弟帮我炼制丹药，但我更想让聘请小兄弟成为我的专用炼丹师，小兄弟放心，成为我的专用炼丹师，我一定不会亏待你的，我可以保证你在这贺州坊市的地位无人敢惹。“
洛豪心里冷笑一声，想让他成为专用炼丹师，说好听点那是专用炼丹师，说不好听点那就是他的炼丹奴隶，如果不是这老头实力比他强，他早就将黑蛛刀拔了出来，一刀劈了过去了，真当他是傻子吗?于是洛豪直接就摇了摇头，“对不起前辈，我还有事情要做，不能在贺州坊市呆太久，不过前辈要是找我炼制丹药，只要前辈提供药材，我还是很乐意为前辈炼丹的。“

贺长老听了洛豪的话，脸色顿时沉了下来，他可是一个成丹高手，低声下气邀请一个结真修士已经是对这个结真修士不错了，要不是看这个结真修士是一个三品炼丹师，他早就一巴掌将他变成碎渣了。
何况在这贺州坊市，他贺长老可是地位最高的几人之一了，这个结真修士居然还敢拒绝他，这是不把他放在眼里，好在这个修士话还没有说的那么绝对，答应帮他炼丹，要不然的话，他早就杀了这个结真修士，不过是一个三品炼丹师，居然敢拒绝他。
贺长老没有再说话，而是拂袖离去。
洛豪一看贺长老离去，就知道自己现在十分的危险，不过贺州坊市的拍卖会，洛豪也不想放弃，拍卖会上肯定有不少好东西，所谓富贵险中求，虽然他现在打不过这个贺长老，但是他相信他是能够从这个贺长老手中逃走的。
……
来到拍卖会入口，拍卖会里面就已经坐了不少修士，洛豪仔细询问了一番，知道拍卖会有高级中级和低级包厢，高级包厢不用说也知道是提供给那些有强大背景势力或者自身实力强大的修士，当然如果你比较富有也可以花高价去购买。
高级包厢一共一万上品灵石，中级包厢一间也是一万中品灵石，只有低级包厢还好一点，只要一千下品灵石，不过低级包厢根本就没有什么好的服务，高级和中级包厢至少还布置的有阵法。不过洛豪根本就不关心这些，选了一个十分靠后的低级包厢，洛豪立即就付了一千下品灵石。
进入了包厢，洛豪还没有坐下来，一道强悍的神识就从他的包厢扫过，洛豪知道这是成丹中期的神识，洛豪心里也是暗暗吃惊，没想到一个拍卖会竟然有成丹期高手坐镇，不过这也是为了防止交易修士之间的公平。
那道神识扫过之后，拍卖会场上就出现了一个漂亮的女修，这个女修的实力并不高，只有结真中期，但是她的美貌也给她带来了一些掌声。只见她挥了挥手，轻灵的声音瞬间飘出，“欢迎大家来参加贺州坊市的拍卖会，本次拍卖会一定不会让大家失望的。
好了我也不多说，接下来咱们来看第一件拍品。这是一个下品攻击灵器长枪，是虚灵虎的虎牙打造成的，底价为一千下品灵石，有请大家出价。“
她的话音刚落，立即就有修士按捺不住了，“二千下品灵石。“
“三千下品灵石。“
“四千下品灵石“。
……
洛豪对这个下品攻击灵器是没有兴趣的，毕竟他的黑蛛刀就已经是极品攻击灵器了，所以洛豪并没有出价，最后是一个低级包厢的修士花了五千下品灵石买下了这个下品攻击灵器长枪。
接下来是拍卖的一个下品飞行灵器，是一个飞船，底价依然是一千下品灵石，洛豪一眼就看中了这个飞船，正好他现在缺一个飞行灵器，所以洛豪直接就报价了，“一千下品灵石。“
只是洛豪不知道的是，他看中了这个飞行灵器，别的修士自然也看中了，“二千下品灵石。“
“三千下品灵石。“
“四千下品灵石“。
……

洛豪的报价很快就被压了下去。
content_en:
After taking out the purchased third-grade alchemy furnace, Luo Hao put the true heart grass and some auxiliary medicinal materials into the alchemy furnace at the same time, and then began to use real fire to melt and purify these medicinal materials. This is also the first step in alchemy. This step can only succeed and cannot fail. Luo Hao kept changing his gestures, and at the same time his consciousness was always monitoring the situation in the alchemy furnace. Because it was his first time to make alchemy, Luo Hao was extra careful.
After half a stick of incense, Luo Hao finally purified the medicinal materials completely. Although the purity was not 100%, it was about 95%. Luo Hao knew that it was not that he could not purify 100%, nor was there a problem with his alchemy technique, but that he did not have a strange fire. Strange fire is one of the necessary items for an alchemist. Just like a fish cannot live without water, if an alchemist does not have a strange fire, the alchemist will never be able to advance to a higher level.
If it were other alchemists, it would be difficult to purify medicinal materials to more than 90% using ordinary real fire. Luo Hao's ability to purify to 95% is considered very powerful.
After purifying the medicinal materials, Luo Hao began to refine the elixir. Luo Hao drove one alchemy hand after another into the alchemy furnace, and Luo Hao also used his spiritual consciousness to control the rotation of the liquid. As Luo Hao's hands continued to enter, the purified liquid began to solidify slowly, then decomposed, and then solidified again. After a stick of incense, the liquid in the alchemy furnace began to gradually become spiritual.
A burst of elixir fragrance flew out. When Luo Hao smelled this burst of elixir fragrance, he knew that the Zhen Gathering Pill had been successfully refined. Luo Hao pulled it out, and twelve Zhen Gathering Pills were pulled out by Luo Hao. Then Luo Hao took out a jade bottle and put the twelve Zhen Gathering Pills in it, and then stretched out his hand to wipe the sweat on his head.
After looking at the twelve truth-gathering pills in the jade bottle, all of them were top-grade, Luo Hao was quite satisfied. This time the refining did not consume too much of his true energy, but it consumed a lot of his spiritual consciousness. However, after resting for a while, Luo Hao's spiritual consciousness was almost restored. Luo Hao then refined another furnace of blood-rejuvenating pills, a furnace of rejuvenation pills, and a furnace of spiritual pills. After refining these three furnaces of pills, Luo Hao had consumed most of his true energy and spiritual consciousness. Fortunately, he could take both the rejuvenating pills and divine spiritual pills to make up for the lost true energy and spiritual consciousness.
So Luo Hao immediately swallowed a rejuvenation pill and a spirit pill. It has to be said that the recovery effects between pills and spiritual herbs are completely incomparable. In the past, Luo Hao had to consume several rejuvenation roots and several divine spirit herbs to restore his true energy and consciousness. But this time, he only swallowed a rejuvenation pill refined from the divine grass to restore his consciousness, and a rejuvenation pill refined from the rejuvenation root restored his true essence.
After successfully refining these elixirs, Luo Hao knew that he was already a first-level alchemist. Next, he would refine a furnace of Po Zhen Dan and a furnace of Condensing Yuan Dan. As for the Grass Spirit Pill, Luo Hao had not thought about refining it for the time being, because he could not use the Grass Spirit Pill yet, because it was more suitable to refine the Grass Spirit Pill when he was in the stage of becoming an elixir. When Luo Hao completes refining the Yuan Condensing Pill, Luo Hao will be a second-grade alchemist. In fact, after refining the Po-Zhen Pill, Luo Hao can be regarded as a second-grade alchemist, because the Po-Zhen Pill can also be regarded as a second-grade elixir.
After another stick of incense passed, Luo Hao finally finished refining a batch of truth-breaking pills. He took two of the twelve truth-breaking pills and put them in another jade bottle. Luo Hao put the other ten truth-breaking pills in the jade bottle and put them into the book of chaos. The other ones he refined included blood rejuvenation pills and rejuvenation pills. Both pills and spirit pills were put into the book of chaos by Luo Hao. Only the gathering pills were left in the storage bag by Luo Hao, because after refining the pills, Luo Hao planned to break through to the middle stage of knotting here. He believed that twelve gathering pills were enough for him to break through to the middle stage of knotting.
Another stick of incense passed by, Luo Hao also refined a batch of twelve Yuan Condensing Pills, and then Luo Hao arranged them at the entrance of the cave.He set up a level three defensive formation and a level three trapping formation, and then put down a monitoring array. After being fully prepared, Luo Hao entered the Book of Chaos. Luo Hao knew that the movement of his breakthrough was very loud, and he couldn't even try to cover it up even if he arranged the formation, so Luo Hao decided to break through in the Book of Chaos. As for setting up the monitoring defense formation and trapping formation, he was afraid that someone would come to the cave to disturb him.
After entering the Book of Chaos, Luo Hao found a random place and sat down cross-legged, and then swallowed a Zhenzhen Pill. The moment he swallowed the Zhenzhen Pill, it turned into medicinal liquid and filled Luo Hao's meridians. Countless spiritual energy began to transform into real energy. Luo Hao felt as comfortable as taking a bath to wash away the dirt on his body.
A whirlpool of spiritual energy began to appear on top of Luo Hao's head, and then Luo Hao began to attack the meridian barrier in the middle stage of Jie Zhen. Countless true energy impacted the meridian barrier. However, after an hour passed, Luo Hao found that a Zhen Zhen Pill could not allow him to break through to the middle stage of Jie Zhen, so Luo Hao swallowed another Zhen Yuan. Dan, finally this Zhen Gathering Pill was transforming into countless zhenyuan and impacted Luo Hao's meridians. He heard a click and felt the meridians shattering and then expanding. Luo Hao knew that he had finally broken through to the middle stage of Jizhen. Feeling the powerful zhenyuan in the middle stage of Jizhen, Luo Hao roared and felt relaxed all over his body.
Two days later, Elder He was getting impatient and was about to force his way into Luo Hao's cave. At this moment, Luo Hao finally came out of the cave. After a night of consolidation, Luo Hao finally consolidated his mid-term strength. Then Luo Hao calculated that three days were almost here. Luo Hao did not continue to practice and break through, but planned to go to the auction. Unexpectedly, as soon as he came out of the cave, he saw Elder He who was waiting to break into his cave.
Luo Hao took a closer look and saw that this was a thin old man with a beard. Looking at his strength, Luo Hao was shocked. This old man was actually at the early stage of becoming a pill. Why was this old man here looking for him? At the same time, Luo Hao became very vigilant.
Seeing Luo Hao come out, Elder He clasped his hands and asked, "Can this little brother have a chat?"
"I wonder what senior wants to do with me?" Although Luo Hao was very vigilant in his heart, he still pretended to be very calm on the surface. Although he couldn't beat the old man, as long as he found a chance, he could use his spiritual consciousness to escape.
"I am the steward of Hezhoufang City. You can also call me Elder He. I heard that the little brother bought a third-grade alchemy furnace in Hezhou Commercial Building. I wonder if the little brother is a third-grade alchemist?" Elder He asked Luo Hao very calmly.
Luo Hao was shocked when he heard this. He didn't expect that he would be targeted just after he bought an alchemy furnace. Although he was very afraid of this old man, Luo Hao still answered respectfully, "I am a third-level alchemy master. Senior, you are looking for me to refine elixirs?"
Elder He smiled happily when he heard this, "Yes, I want to ask my little brother to help me refine the elixir, but I also want to hire this little brother to be my dedicated alchemist. Don't worry, little brother, I will not treat you badly if you become my dedicated alchemist. I can guarantee that no one dares to mess with your status in Hezhoufang City."
Luo Hao sneered in his heart and wanted him to become a dedicated alchemist. To put it nicely, he would be a dedicated alchemist. To put it badly, he would be his alchemy slave. If the old man hadn't been stronger than him, he would have pulled out the black spider knife and slashed it with one blow. Really Do you think he is a fool? So Luo Hao simply shook his head, "I'm sorry, senior, I still have things to do and can't stay in Hezhoufang City for too long. However, if senior asks me to refine elixirs, I will still be happy to refine elixirs for seniors as long as he provides the medicinal materials."
After hearing Luo Hao's words, Elder He's face suddenly darkened. He was a master of elixir creation. To invite a Jiuzhen monk in such a low voice was already a good treatment for this Jiuzhen monk.If it weren't for the fact that this solid monk was a third-grade alchemist, he would have turned him into slag with a slap.
What's more, in Hezhoufang City, he, Elder He, is one of the highest-ranking people. This Jie Zhen monk actually dared to refuse him. This was because he didn't take him seriously. Fortunately, this monk didn't say so absolutely and agreed to help him make alchemy. Otherwise, he would have killed this Jie Zhen monk. He was just a third-grade alchemist, but he actually dared to reject him.
Elder He did not speak any more, but walked away.
As soon as Luo Hao saw Elder He leaving, he knew that he was in great danger now. However, Luo Hao did not want to give up on the auction in Hezhoufang City. There must be many good things in the auction. The so-called wealth is found in danger. Although he cannot defeat Elder He now, he believes that he can escape from Elder He.
…
Arriving at the entrance of the auction, there were already many monks sitting in the auction. Luo Hao inquired carefully and learned that the auction had high-level, mid-level and low-level boxes. Needless to say, the high-level boxes were provided to those monks with strong backgrounds or powerful abilities. Of course, if you are richer, you can also buy them at a high price.
There are a total of 10,000 high-grade spiritual stones in the high-level private rooms, and 10,000 mid-grade spiritual stones in the intermediate private rooms. Only the low-level private rooms are better, only needing 1,000 lower-grade spiritual stones. However, the low-level private rooms do not have any good services at all. The high-level private rooms are at least equipped with formations. However, Luo Hao didn't care about this at all and chose a low-level box very far back. Luo Hao immediately paid a thousand low-grade spiritual stones.
Entering the box, before Luo Hao sat down, a powerful spiritual consciousness swept across his box. Luo Hao knew that this was the spiritual consciousness of the middle stage of becoming an elixir. Luo Hao was also secretly surprised. He did not expect that an auction would be attended by masters of the stage of becoming an elixir. However, this was also to prevent fairness among the transaction monks.
After the divine consciousness swept over, a beautiful female cultivator appeared on the auction floor. This female cultivator was not very strong, only in the middle stage of Jizhen, but her beauty also brought her some applause. I saw her waving her hand, and her light voice suddenly floated out, "Welcome everyone to participate in the auction in Hezhoufang City. This auction will definitely not disappoint you.
Okay, I won’t say much more, let’s take a look at the first lot. This is a low-grade attack spiritual weapon spear. It is made from the teeth of the Void Spirit Tiger. The base price is one thousand low-grade spiritual stones. Please bid. "
As soon as she finished speaking, a monk couldn't hold himself back and said, "Two thousand low-grade spiritual stones."
"Three thousand low-grade spiritual stones."
"Four thousand low-grade spiritual stones."
…
Luo Hao was not interested in this low-grade attack weapon. After all, his Black Spider Sword was already a top-grade attack weapon, so Luo Hao did not bid. In the end, a monk from a low-level box spent 5,000 low-grade spiritual stones to buy the low-grade attack weapon spear.
Next was a low-grade flying spiritual weapon that was auctioned. It was a spaceship. The base price was still one thousand low-grade spiritual stones. Luo Hao took a fancy to this spaceship at a glance. It happened that he was short of a flying spiritual weapon now, so Luo Hao directly quoted, "One thousand low-grade spiritual stones."
